policy.missing_value_policy: A missing value is never imputed. A material is ranked only if the weight of criteria that have a value at or above min_grade is at least min_completeness. Scores use only available criteria with weights renormalised, and are labelled partial.

grades.B: recognised published dataset or peer-reviewed study (check geography)
grades.C: generic industry average, aggregator record, secondary report or estimate - provisional
grades.D: missing / unsupported - never contributes to a ranking

statuses.read_primary: value taken from a primary document that was opened and read
statuses.secondary_reported: value reported by an unverified secondary summary; check the primary document
statuses.derived: calculated by this platform from cited inputs

retv.locator: Sec. 9.5.2 and Table 48 (warm-humid); omega: Table 49 (lat < 23.5 N)
retv.formula_note: RETV = (1/A_envelope) [ a*sum(A_op*U_op*w) + b*sum(A_win*U_win*w) + c*sum(A_win*SHGC_eq*w) ]. Eq. 4 is an image in the ENS PDF; the form here follows the variable list printed beneath it (Sec. 9.5.3) and must be checked against the printed equation.

ratings._note: Rating-system and code requirements relevant to external-wall material choice. 'verified' = text read in the primary document on 2026-11-04 (see sources.json). Nothing here awards or implies rating points for any product.

items.requirement: RETV of the building envelope (except roof) <= 15 W/m2 for composite, hot-dry, warm-humid and temperate zones. BEE notes an intended future tightening to 12 W/m2.
items.applies_to: whole envelope (walls + openings), not a single wall material

items.requirement: Warm-humid RETV formula coefficients a=5.15, b=1.31, c=65.21 (formula itself, Eq. 4, not transcribed here).
Wall U-value = 1/(Rsi + sum(t/k) + Rse) with Rsi=0.13, Rse=0.04 m2K/W; Table 46 gives default conductivities; measured values per IS codes may replace them.
k = 0.0652 exp(0.0012 rho) for solid fired clay brick (1250-2150 kg/m3); k = 0.1009 exp(0.0011 rho) for non-fired units incl. AAC, concrete block, fly ash brick, CSEB (600-2100 kg/m3).
items.applies_to: masonry units with measured dry density

items.requirement: Kochi and Trivandrum are classified Warm-Humid. Kollam is not listed in the extracted table; adjacent-city classification is an inference.

All internal and external walls built from alternative materials: concrete blocks (hollow, solid or AAC) with >=40% fly ash by weight; hollow clay blocks; adobe/stabilised adobe/CSEB/stabilised mud blocks; rammed earth; stones from India (not cladding); bamboo/rapidly renewable material; monolithic concrete wall with >=20% OPC replacement; C&D waste blocks with >=30% C&D waste; dry walls/boards with >=5% recycled content. Evidence: purchase orders, BOQ, mix design or valid GRIHA Product Catalogue certificate (19.2.8-19.2.13).
>=30% replacement of OPC with BIS-recommended waste by weight in masonry mortar and plaster.

GWP reduction vs a project-specific GRIHA LCA base case: superstructure 10-15% = 1 point, >15% = 2 points; interiors and finishes 10-15% = 1, 15-30% = 2, >30% = 3. Needs a third-party LCA calculator report, EPDs or GRIHA Product Catalogue certificates.

Thermal comfort by simulation (NBC 2016 / ASHRAE 55 / Indian Adaptive Comfort): non-AC spaces 60% of occupied hours in warm-humid climate (90% elsewhere), or Alternative 2 natural-ventilation strategies.
